packmod.pack_conversion.title: Resource Pack Conversion
packmod.pack_conversion.question: This pack does not support the current client version. Convert it with 2-Pyramid? Your original is kept and the converted copy is placed in the resource pack folder. Complex models, shaders or overlays may still need manual adjustments.

packmod.pack_conversion.options_preview: Save, then preview tasks before converting.
packmod.pack_conversion.option_help.clea: Allows legacy model/blockstate and asset deletion. Check appearance afterwards.
packmod.pack_conversion.option_help.gene: Generate resources using upstream rules. May change the original style.
packmod.pack_conversion.option_help.shad: Experimental shader rewriting. Disabled shaders are retained with a review warning.
packmod.pack_conversion.option_help.alph: Enable upstream alpha-layer fixes; inspect transparent textures afterwards.
packmod.pack_conversion.option_help.over: Merge overlays active at the declared source format, in order, then migrate. Output targets one version; original retained.
packmod.pack_conversion.option_help.budg: Estimate the largest image at 16 bytes per pixel per worker plus cache reserve. Reduce concurrency before refusing; never sum all pack images. This is not a process memory limit.
packmod.pack_conversion.restore_help: Move the archived original back. Name collisions get a suffix; converted outputs remain available.
packmod.pack_conversion.archive_review_h: Use after checking the output in game. Enabled, selected or changed originals cannot be archived.
packmod.pack_conversion.runner_missing: This build does not bundle a runner for your OS/CPU.
packmod.pack_conversion.preview_note: Version route and task switches; file changes appear in the result report.
packmod.pack_conversion.warning.overlays: Source overlays merged; output targets one version. Original retained.
packmod.pack_conversion.warning.models_p: Legacy model cleanup skipped; verify custom model rendering.
packmod.pack_conversion.warning.shaders_: Shader migration disabled; verify shader effects.
packmod.pack_conversion.retry_help: Retry with the recorded options. Original must still match and be unused. Published outputs are never reconverted by this action.
packmod.pack_conversion.warning.mixed_re: Different texture resolutions were sampled. Conversion succeeded; inspect GUI and inventory alignment. This warning does not prove an actual visual defect.
packmod.pack_conversion.repair.image_enc: Image encoding normalized to PNG without resizing: %s
packmod.pack_conversion.repair.format_ra: Source version range replaced with the target format.
packmod.pack_conversion.diagnostic_help: Export redacted text reports to packmod-tools/pyramid/diagnostics. No resource-pack contents are included.
